sentences.en: The landlord won't permit him to paint the door red.
sentences.zh: 房东不会允许他把门漆成红色。

sentences.en: If you don't pay rent, the landlord will evict you.
sentences.zh: 如果你不交房租，房东会把你赶出去。

sentences.en: Sami asked his landlord to give him his bond back.
sentences.zh: 萨米要求他的房东退还押金。

senses.zh: 房东，地主；酒店老板，小酒馆老板
